caption: Do not throw out bendy celery. #KitchenHacks #NoWaste

beats.shot: extreme close-up on a limp celery stalk bending over
beats.does: bends a floppy celery stalk in half
pours a big handful of salt into a bowl of water and stirs
beats.says: Soak it in very salty water.

beats.does: pushes the celery stalks into the salty water
beats.says: The salt pulls water back into the stalk.

beats.does: lifts a stiff celery stalk out of the salty water and snaps it

beats.says: Salt water brings it back every time.
